dataset.name: Momentum: 2020 vaccine-news day
dataset.caption: Kenneth French's daily momentum factor (long last year's winners, short last year's losers). Window: the 750 trading days ending 2020-12-31 (2018-01-10 to 2020-12-31); the first 250 (to 2019-01-08) are the warm-up the tool learns 'normal' from. Why this window: it contains 9 Nov 2020, when vaccine news hit momentum for -14.4%, its worst day of 2020. Same rule for every real dataset. Thresholds were tuned on strategies simulated from the warm-up fit, never on these returns. Source: Kenneth R. French Data Library.
